Description: One of the most unexpected moments in our career was during a spontanious acoustic concert in Milkwaukee. We had just finished an amazing and high energy show, but the night still felt young. The crowd wasn’t ready for the night to end, and neither were we. We got our guitars and started playing a few of our songs acoustic, with just us and the audience. Fans gathered around the stage to listen, quiet lyrics rang through the air as the crowd sang. This is why we love small venues, it allows for an intimate and personal conversation between us and the crowd, giving the music more weight in that moment. The way the crowd listened and gathered made that night one of the most memorable of our entire career.
